picks.headline: Eddie AI v4 adds Avid support, C2PA signing, and generative b-roll
picks.excerpt: Eddie AI v4 adds native Avid Media Composer handoff, automatic camera sync, and generative music, voiceover and b-roll. It also signs output with C2PA content credentials and offers a smaller on-premises model for facilities.
picks.rationale: Assistant-editor AI now hands off natively to Avid, signs its output with C2PA, and runs on-prem — a concrete change to tomorrow's cutting-room setup.

picks.headline: AI-Generated Verticals Are Flooding the Microdrama Apps That Kept Crews Working
picks.excerpt: Phone-first microdramas became a post-strike lifeline for underemployed LA cast and crew. Now AI-generated verticals are saturating the same apps, and auditions are drying up.
picks.rationale: The clearest field report yet on where generative video is actually displacing paid production work — the vertical microdrama market, not features.

picks.headline: SNS Adds AI Suite Advanced, Avid Media Composer Support to EVO
picks.excerpt: Studio Network Solutions expanded the AI layer inside its EVO shared storage, pushing transcription, tagging and search onto the facility's own hardware. The IBC update also widens Avid Media Composer compatibility.
picks.rationale: Transcription, tagging and search move into the shared storage itself and stay on the facility's own hardware — the on-prem answer to cloud media AI.

picks.headline: Guillermo Del Toro On What Artists Lose To AI: 'You're Never A Master; You're Always An Apprentice'
picks.excerpt: Del Toro uses the Pale Man, practical effects and creative accidents to argue what disappears when process is replaced by prompting. His framing is about craft apprenticeship, not copyright.
picks.rationale: A craft argument rather than a copyright one: what a creative team loses when the process that trains people is replaced by a prompt.

picks.headline: Daniel Kwan and Joseph Gordon-Levitt's CCAI Launches a Site to Define AI's Impact
picks.excerpt: The Concerned Creatives coalition led by Daniel Kwan and Joseph Gordon-Levitt is publishing a living web resource mapping how AI is actually hitting creative work. It aims to give filmmakers shared evidence rather than vibes.
picks.rationale: A filmmaker-built, continuously updated evidence base creatives can cite in real negotiations instead of trading anecdotes.
